description: One journal entry, as the host projects it to the reader (world-entry, world-entries, world-resolve). The identity's own principal sees the whole entry; anyone else sees a refusal as its public projection and any other entry as its chain fields, identity, turn, outcome tag and the roots and writes of objects it may view.

main.description: Record key: the entry's slug (two proquint words) or its CID. The record's cid is the entry's `hash`: the CID of its canonical DAG-CBOR bytes without `hash`; com.atproto.sync.getRecord serves those bytes to a reader who may see the whole entry.

slug.description: The first 32 bits of the hash's digest as two proquint words; what a post cites.

roots.description: The roots the turn read, those the reader may view.

outcome.description: `{tag, ...}`: created, admitted, refused, suspended, ... (HOST-HANDOFF section 2). Projected: `{tag, writes?}`.

elided.description: Roots and writes of objects the reader may not view.

class.description: A public refusal's class (staleRoot, lawRefused, unknownObject, ...).

root.description: A public refusal's root: the object and the version the turn read it at.

object.description: A public refusal's named object when it differs from its root.
